senses.gloss: m. (בסם, with inserted ל = ר; hence βάλσαμον which was readopted as בלסמון; cmp. בְּלוּזְמָא) balsam, aromatic gum.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 91:11">Gen. R. s. 91</cite> (interpr. <cite ref="R00759"><he>צרי</he></cite>) <he>בלסם קטף</he> the gum of the balsam tree.—
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Song of Songs 7:14">Targ. Cant. VII, 14</cite>.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 31">Lev. R. s. 31</cite>; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:15">Cant. R. to I, 15</cite>; a. e. Cmp. <cite ref="Q01109"><he>פַּלְסְמוֹן</he></cite> a. <cite ref="A02832"><he>אַפַּרְסָמוֹן</he></cite>.
